But she found herself among a number of women in Darwin struggling to book an appointment, with some forced to travel hundreds of kilometres, head interstate or miss out altogether. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Roxanne Fitzgerald

item.title: Small businesses fighting to stay open amid 'insidious cost creep'
item.description: Small business owners hit with rising costs will no longer be able to add surcharges on card payments from October 1. One operator in regional South Australia has described it as an "insidious cost creep". Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Liz Rymill and Becc Bird

item.title: Polling officials say they were ignored after offering to work at SA election
item.description: South Australia's Electoral Commission did not follow up with polling officials who indicated they wanted to work at the 2026 state election, multiple former officials say. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Thomas Kelsall

item.title: Second child dies after crash west of Melbourne
item.description: An 11-year-old boy died in hospital overnight following the single-vehicle crash at Parwan that claimed the life of a seven-year-old girl. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Foreign 'AI slopaganda' network deepfakes dozens of Australian politicians
item.description: Dozens of Australian politicians have been deepfaked by a "foreign influence" network operating on Facebook, and researchers say there are many more just like it. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Ange Lavoipierre

item.title: Prime Video Orders Australian Originals ‘Free Spirits: The Backpacker Poisonings,’ ‘Madness of Three’ and ‘The Test’ Season 4
item.description: Prime Video has ordered three new Australian original titles, growing its local slate to 34 commissions since 2019. The new titles include two true-crime docuseries and a fourth season of the sports documentary “The Test,” all launching from 2027. “Free Spirits: The Backpacker Poisonings” (w/t) follows eight backpackers, including two Australians, who traveled through Southeast […] Fuente: Variety.
item.dc:creator: Naman Ramachandran

item.title: Woman allegedly attacked in Brisbane emergency department
item.description: A 73-year-old woman was allegedly punched in the face "a number of times" in an unprovoked attack at a major Brisbane hospital. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Emma Pollard

item.title: 'Lowering the bar': New Tasmanian targets may mean longer surgery waits
item.description: A revised health performance target will allow for up to almost one in three Tasmanian elective surgery patients to wait longer than they should for surgery. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Clancy Balen

item.title: Who is taking the biggest cut of the apple profits?
item.description: Growers are welcoming higher prices for apples, but say they want the ACCC to better police the relationship between major supermarkets and farmers. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Warwick Long and Justine Longmore

item.title: Man wanted over axe attack arrested in Victoria's east
item.description: Peter O'Ryan, 48, had been on the run since allegedly attacking family members with an axe at Tyers on Saturday. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Victims of serious youth crimes to be told when offenders leave prison
item.description: Victims of the most serious youth crimes could be notified when offenders leave prison under significant changes to Victoria's youth justice system due at the end of the month. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Olivia Jenkins

item.title: Anthony Albanese held undeclared honorary membership to golf club awarded $6 million
item.description: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese held an honorary membership to the Marrickville Golf Club in his seat, which was promised $6 million at the 2025 election through an invite-only scheme, and which Mr Albanese has not declared. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Jake Evans

item.title: Will your feed be boring without the algorithm? Instagram gives us a hint
item.description: The government wants to give social media users more control over their feeds. But what steps already exist for users to curate what they see online? Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Erin Handley

item.title: Can Australia produce another outback film classic?
item.description: Forty years on from Paul Hogan's iconic role as Crocodile Dundee, tourism and production houses are still riding an economic high on its success. But could another box office hit be hard to recreate? Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Sinéad Mangan, Christopher Testa, and Em Jensen

item.title: Schumacher comparisons made as Antonelli continues historic F1 season
item.description: Kimi Antonelli's win from 19th on the grid in Monza was epic, and the way his rivals raced with him has drawn comparisons with Ferrari legend Michael Schumacher. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Michael Doyle

item.title: Government to stop super being drained through fraud
item.description: Perpetrators of domestic violence would be punished rather than rewarded for their actions when committing abuse against their former partners through the tax and super systems. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Nassim Khadem

item.title: Student visa refusals hit 10-year high, shattering dreams
item.description: Australia's student visa refusal rate hits a 10-year high, with countries such as Nepal and India facing rejections of more than 40 per cent. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Natasya Salim

item.title: Whistleblowers allege fraud in $7.2b battery subsidy plan
item.description: Almost 100 whistleblower tip-offs claim dodgy operators are rorting a multi-billion-dollar taxpayer-funded solar battery program by mocking up installs, forging signatures and using unlicensed tradies for cash jobs. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Michael Atkin and Lucy Kent

item.title: New molecular magnet design boosts performance for ultrahigh-density data storage
item.description: Researchers at The University of Manchester and the Australian National University have developed a new class of molecular magnets that combines the most successful features of previous designs, resulting in some of the strongest magnetic memory properties reported to date. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Boyfriend of Simone Strobel breaks silence after 20 years
item.description: More than 20 years after he last spoke publicly, Tobias Moran tells the ABC he did not kill his girlfriend Simone Strobel in Lismore in 2005 and accuses the police of unfairly targeting him. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Richard Baker

item.title: Colin from Accounts star leads new thriller set in bushranger country
item.description: The Australian actor has spent the year wrapping up the show he co-created and starring in The Devil Wears Prada 2. Now, he leads a local thriller. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Hannah Story

item.title: Quiz: We're taking you around the world in 10 questions
item.description: Where would you find the Big Penguin? And Vientiane is the capital of which South-East Asian country? Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: 'Who am I now?' Mums and dads reflect on the grief of becoming empty-nesters
item.description: From “existential emptiness” to grief, parents share the myriad emotions they felt when their children left home. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Amy Sheehan

item.title: Climate change may erase 25 million hectares of kelp forests by 2050
item.description: Climate change is driving rapid declines in seaweed forests globally, outpacing restoration efforts and undermining seaweed restoration as a viable carbon dioxide removal strategy, according to an essay by Karen Filbee-Dexter at the University of Western Australia and colleagues, published Sept. 8 in the journal PLOS Biology. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Mo’Nique Signs With Innovative
item.description: Mo’Nique has signed with Innovative Artists Entertainment for representation in all areas, Variety has learned. She continues to be repped by attorney Ricky Anderson and manager Sidney Hicks. Mo’Nique first broke out as a stand up comic, including being one of the stars of the stand up film “The Queens of Comedy.” She earned a […] Fuente: Variety.
item.dc:creator: Joseph Otterson

item.title: Five killed as Russia resumes strikes on Kyiv after pause for US envoys' visit
item.description: The strikes came as US President Donald Trump and Russian counterpart Vladimir Putin held an hour-long phone conversation about talks between their envoys in recent days. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Navy Chief Krishna Swaminathan to visit Australia, New Zealand; naval ties set to receive boost
item.description: The visits aim to further strengthen bilateral naval cooperation with the Royal Australian Navy and the Royal New Zealand Navy Fuente: The Hindu - International.

item.title: New documents reveal what NYC knew about air toxicity after 9/11
item.description: New York City's mayor Zohran Mamdani has released 170,000 pages of documents detailing what was known about air pollution that billowed from Ground Zero after the attacks. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Dozens injured as Yemen's Houthis launch strikes on Saudi oil facilities
item.description: The Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia appears to be a major expansion of the war in the Midlde East and have the potential to disrupt energy supplies beyond the blockaded Strait of Hormuz. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: In 2023, an Australian cattle station sold for $40 million for a carbon project; three years later...
item.description: After a disappointing turn of events, Benmara Station, a prominent cattle property in Australia, was sold for A$26 million, significantly lower than its original price of A$40 million. This decline resulted from the cancellation of an ambitious environmental project related to carbon farming, emphasizing traditional pastoral values instead of its former carbon potential as regulatory challenges mounted. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Flushing the toilet can release a ‘plume’ of breathable pathogens – and closing the lid won’t stop their escape
item.description: New research shows turbulent flushes create toilet-generated aerosols that can transmit legionella, influenza and norovirus Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Flushing toilets release particles into the “breathing zone” of adults and can remain suspended in the air for at least 20 seconds, a new study has found. And closing the lid might not be enough to avoid a “plume” of potential pathogens. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.
item.dc:creator: Tory Shepherd
